newsitem.title: USA: NAPM-New York business conditions 53.9 in February.
newsitem.headline: NAPM-New York business conditions 53.9 in February.

text.p: The National Association of Purchasing Management (NAPM) index of New York-area business conditions fell to 53.9 in February from 61.9 in January.
The New York-area non-manufacturing conditions index fell to 54.8 in February from 62.8 the month before.
Manufacturing-sector conditions also fell, to 45.9 from 53.9, the "lowest reading since April 1996," the report said.
An index above 50 denotes growth, NAPM said.
"Although the pace of manufacturing and non-manufacturing business conditions both were weaker, there was a decisively negative reading for the manufacturing sector," it said.
NAPM's New York business outlook index, which looks ahead about six months, read 68.9 in February, just below the 71.7 registerd in January.
"Looking forward to the upcoming six months, purchasers' optimisim remained high in February," NAPM said.
